title: Trace Coordinates and Local Fenchel--Nielsen Parameters in Real Hyperbolic 5-Space
summary: We study representations of fundamental groups of closed orientable surfaces into \(\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{H})\), whose projectivization \(\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{H})\) is the group of orientation-preserving isometries of real hyperbolic \(5\)-space, with the aim of developing a quaternionic analogue of Fenchel--Nielsen theory. We give a normal form for pairs of regular loxodromic elements with disjoint fixed point sets and show that, on an open dense generic locus, the corresponding moduli space is \(15\)-dimensional.
